cases.name: Lacey Marie Toole
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Lacey was born in Augusta, Georgia and she worked for Shift Mart. Lacey always tried to put a smile on everyone’s face- even on their darkest days. She selflessly always put everyone’s needs before her own. She loved helping or doing what she could for anyone but most of all she loved spending time with her family and especially her children."
